name: Charan Mandir
description:
Starting from the iconic Garh Ganesh Temple, this trek is one of Jaipur’s most scenic ridge walks, leading you to the peaceful heights of Charan Mandir.

The journey begins with a climb to Garh Ganesh, where you’re greeted by panoramic views of Jaipur city. From here, the real adventure starts — a ridge trail cutting through the Aravalli hills, offering breathtaking views on both sides. The path is a mix of rocky terrain, narrow ridges, and natural trails, making it exciting yet beginner-friendly.

As you walk along the ridge, you’ll witness Jaipur like never before — Nahargarh Fort on one side, Jal Mahal shimmering in the distance, and endless hills all around. The final stretch takes you to Charan Mandir, a quiet spiritual spot nestled amidst nature, perfect to relax and soak in the views.

name: Twin Tower
description:
Hidden in the heart of the Aravalli Hills, the Twin Tower Trek is one of Jaipur’s most underrated adventures. Starting near Galta Gate, this trail takes you through जंगल vibes, rocky paths, and peaceful nature, far from city chaos.

The trek leads you to two abandoned broadcast towers standing tall on the hilltop — giving you a surreal 360° view of Jaipur. From here, you can witness stunning landscapes including Sisodiya Rani Bagh and Amagarh Fort. 

Whether it’s a sunrise trek with golden skies or a sunset vibe with cool हवा, this experience is all about sukoon + adventure.
The Great Wall of Amer (Jaipur Wall) is frequently described by local tourism sources and media as the "third longest wall in the world," it does not currently hold an official world record.
name: The Wall Amer
Twin Tower
description:

Hiking In Jaipur During The Golden Hours | JaipurThruMyLens
The Twin Tower Trek in Jaipur is a popular, moderate-level early morning hike to two abandoned, dilapidated towers located in the Amagarh range, starting near Galta Gate. It is a 3-4 hour, 3km trek renowned for offering breathtaking sunrise views of the Aravalli Hills and Sisodia Rani Bagh.

Mount Sumel Sunrise Trek: Escape to the Aravallis!

Looking for the perfect weekend escape in Jaipur? Step away from the hustle and bustle of the city and discover Mount Sumel, one of Jaipur’s best-kept secrets! Nestled near the beautiful Sisodiya Rani Ka Bagh, this offbeat, peaceful trail is a paradise for nature lovers, thrill-seekers, and anyone looking to start their day with a breathtaking sunrise.

And the best part? We are bringing the ultimate mountain vibe to you! After a refreshing climb, reward yourself at the summit with panoramic views of the Jaipur skyline, a steaming hot cup of coffee, and a delicious bowl of Maggi prepared just for you!

What to Expect on the Trail?

The Mount Sumel trek is a hidden gem. The trail kicks off with an easy, relaxing walk along a dusty path before gently winding uphill through the rugged and beautiful Aravalli landscape. As you navigate the rocky patches and wild bushes, you'll be treated to a mix of flat walks and gentle climbs—giving you the thrill of a real trek without being exhausting.

Reaching the top just as the sun peeks over the horizon is an unforgettable experience. Trust us, sipping hot coffee while watching the Pink City wake up from above is the ultimate weekend reset!

Trek Quick Facts:

Difficulty Level: Easy to Moderate. (Perfect for beginners! If you can walk uphill for 20-30 minutes, you are good to go).

Duration: 1 to 2 hours round trip (A perfect half-day adventure).

Distance: Approx. 1 km one way.

Location: Sumel Village (Starts 6 km ahead of Sisodiya Rani Ka Bagh on the Agra Highway).

Best Time: Early Morning (To catch the magical sunrise and beat the heat!).

What We Provide:

A guided trekking experience on an unexplored, raw trail.

Hot Coffee & Freshly Made Maggi at the summit! * Great company, amazing photo opportunities, and memories for a lifetime.

What You Need to Bring:

A water bottle (1–2 liters to stay hydrated)

Good grip hiking or sports shoes (to handle loose gravel)

Comfortable activewear

A cap/hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen

Your phone or camera to capture the stunning aerial views!

Don’t miss out on this raw, serene, and delicious adventure. Whether you are coming solo, with friends, or making it a family outing, the Mount Sumel trek promises peace, panoramic views, and the perfect mountain breakfast.

name: Bhooteswar Mahadev
description:
Most Popular Jaipur Hiking & Trekking Places | JaipurThruMyLens
The Bhuteshwar Mahadev trek in Jaipur is a moderate 2-3 hour hike through the Aravalli hills near Amer, popular during the monsoon for its lush greenery and stunning, panoramic landscape views. The 3-4 km trek starts near the Amer Hathi Stand, leading to an ancient, serene Shiva temple, perfect for nature lovers and adventurers.

The Kedarnath Shiva Temple in Jaipur is a hidden hilltop shrine located in the Kho Nagoriyan area near Jagatpura, offering "Dev Bhoomi" vibes with Aravalli views. It is a popular, accessible trekking spot for locals, providing a peaceful, scenic alternative to the Himalayan journey.
name: Kedarnath

description:
Hidden in the rugged folds of the Aravalli hills, Narsingh Burj trek is one of Jaipur’s lesser-known yet thrilling trails. Perfect for explorers who love offbeat adventures, this trek blends history, raw nature, and stunning city views into one unforgettable experience.

The trail takes you through rocky paths, forest patches, and ancient ruins, gradually leading to the historic Narsingh Burj — a forgotten watchtower that once guarded the region. As you climb higher, the chaos of the city fades away, replaced by peaceful silence and panoramic views of Jaipur.

At the summit, you’re rewarded with 360° views of the Aravalli ranges, old fort structures, and a breathtaking skyline — especially magical during sunrise or sunset.
name: Narsingh Burj

description: Shree Narsingh Mahadev, also known as Naharsingh Burj, is a historic watchtower located near Jal Mahal in Amer, Jaipur. It is part of the extensive fortification ring surrounding the city. This site is associated with historical tales involving a deity image gifted to Queen Bala Bai of Amer.
name: Narsingh Burj

description:
Escape the bustling energy of Jaipur and discover a serene natural escape on our invigorating Bheru Temple trek. Just a short journey from the heart of the Pink City, this accessible 3km adventure promises a refreshing blend of natural beauty and spiritual tranquility, perfect for a rejuvenating half-day outing into the scenic Aravalli hills.

As you embark on this picturesque trail, you'll wind through verdant landscapes, with each step revealing new vistas of the majestic surroundings. The path gently ascends, rewarding your efforts with breathtaking panoramic views that stretch across the city and the rolling hills beyond. The journey itself is a meditative experience, leading you to the ancient Bheru Temple – a peaceful sanctuary that offers not only a stunning backdrop for reflection but also a profound sense of calm away from the urban rhythm.

Join our upcoming expedition, expertly led by the knowledgeable and enthusiastic Mishu, who ensures a safe, enjoyable, and insightful trek for all participants. At an incredible value of just ₹300, this Bheru Temple adventure is an unmissable opportunity to connect with nature, explore the hidden gems of Jaipur, and create lasting memories. Lace up your boots and secure your spot for an unforgettable escape into the heart of Rajasthan's captivating landscapes!
name: Bhooteshwar Nath Trek
